name: batch_create_tasks
description: Create multiple tasks at once. Use when user lists several things to do or wants a repeating schedule. IMPORTANT: When the user asks for a recurring schedule (e.g. Push/Pull/Legs, weekly meal prep, study plan), you MUST assign each task a DIFFERENT date spread across the relevant days. Use day names like 'monday', 'tuesday', etc. — NOT 'every monday' or 'every week'. For a weekly gym rotation, assign each workout to the next occurrence of that specific day. Never put all tasks on the same date.

date.description: Due date. Use: 'today', 'tomorrow', a day name like 'monday'/'tuesday', 'next wednesday', 'in 3 days', or ISO 8601 (2026-02-17). Each task in a batch MUST have its own unique date when scheduling across days.

tasks.description: Array of tasks to create. Each task should have its own date when creating a schedule.
